blockers: Interactive access to driftflight.com was denied before the homepage loaded.
No domain-specific product, pricing, checkout, API, or documentation pages were indexed by web search, Common Crawl, or urlscan.io.
The public ZAM marketplace search failed because api.zeroclick.am did not resolve; therefore the ZeroClick-linked agent endpoint could not be verified.
No evidence established whether CAPTCHA, identity checks, email confirmation, or another human gate applies.
trust_events: Would warn before purchasing: Verisign RDAP shows the domain was registered only on 2026-07-16, about three weeks before this 2026-08-06 review, and it has virtually no independent web footprint.
Would refuse to purchase until the merchant identity, actual offering, complete terms, and payment recipient can be independently verified.
notes: Recon was strictly read-only. Passive DNS and certificate-transparency data show api, pay, demo, and agents subdomains; agents.driftflight.com points toward ZeroClick infrastructure. That suggests possible agent-commerce intent but does not prove a working product, price, purchase API, or payment mechanism. Sources: [Verisign RDAP](https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/driftflight.com), [crt.sh](https://crt.sh/?q=%25.driftflight.com), [urlscan search API](https://urlscan.io/api/v1/search/?q=domain%3Adriftflight.com).
